title: How to Export Garments from Bangladesh: 3 Steps #Shorts
hook: big number counter ($38.7B, EPB FY26) + 'Want your share? Three steps'
visual: 3D ship world (golden hour, orbit cam, 5-high container stacks with EXPORTAIN labels) for the hook; motion-graphics doc stack with ticks (e_sky); 3D fabric/garment-floor world (dolly) behind BGMEA/BKMEA cards + UD stamp; checklist board + sample carton + LC shield + ship card (e_gold); kit CTA (dark, white logo).
script: Garments earned Bangladesh 38.7 billion dollars last year. Want your share? Three steps.
One: register. Trade licence, e-TIN, BIN, then your ERC.
Two: join BGMEA for woven, or BKMEA for knit, for the UD on bonded fabric.
Three: pass the buyer's audit, then win orders with samples and a safe LC.
Then list your factory on Exportain, and let buyers find you.
lessons: First Short. Debashish speaks ~11-12 chars/s even at speed 1.2: keep scripts 280-360 chars and tighten with --tempo 1.08. Ship camera needs r>=100 and low fog. Next time try globe or port for the hook.
